title: UX pass: fast data entry, remembered views, calculators fixed on phones and tablets
changes: Action form: focus goes to the first field at once, so typing right after opening is not lost (found while entering trades by keyboard)
Trade field order for keyboard entry: symbol → quantity → price → fee, then the date (a date input takes three Tab stops)
'Save and add another' keeps the action type, date and market and focuses the symbol
Sale: 'whole quantity (N)' fills what is held on that date; 'last price' fills the latest known price; 'today' / 'yesterday' for the date; these quick buttons stay out of the Tab order
Actions table: 'duplicate' opens a new action with the same details dated today
View choices are remembered between visits: log mode, filter, sort, period, breakdown, performance source, analysis days and pattern (anav.ui.v1)
Dashboard cards: the title keeps its place and the tools wrap below it on narrow screens

Calculators on phones and tablets (pre-existing on dev): the main column was laid out as a row and the input panel collapsed to zero width; it now stacks, the five tabs get their own row, and tab names are readable (11.5px instead of 9px)
